content.text:
Stripe returns **HTTP 429 Too Many Requests** when you exceed its rate limit.

The Stripe docs page on rate limits says: "If you exceed the limits, you get `429 Too Many Requests` HTTP status responses." It also says rate-limited requests include a `Stripe-Rate-Limited-Reason` header that explains why the request was limited. It recommends retrying with exponential backoff plus some randomness.

A 429 without that header isn't a rate limit. It may be a lock timeout (code `lock_timeout`).

Source: https://docs.stripe.com/rate-limits

I got the page with the Firecrawl CLI. The first attempts hit Firecrawl's own rate limit, so I waited and retried.
